next_step: Kickoff Dedicated POC: infra access + canary routing workshop (Decide model variants & rollback criteria)
notes:
Summary:
- Mid-market B2B productivity platform (workflow automation + contextual help).
- Started with Hosted API eval in Q4 2025, satisfied with latency and quality of open models. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

Recent activity / timeline (shorthand):
- 2025-11-10: Intro call (AE Jordan) — product + scale goals. Demo request for conversation and reranking.
- 2025-12-02: Hosted API sandbox used for prototyping embeddings pipeline; team saw 20% faster semantic search vs existing vector store config.
- 2026-01-18: Security questionnaire submitted (SaaS security team). Waiting SOC2 evidence.
- 2026-02-08: Pricing discussion with Jordan + finance; raised desire for predictable committed capacity (monthly).
- 2026-02-25: Demo of Dedicated control plane w/ Priya (SE). Customer asked about canary rollouts & model fallback.
- 2026-03-03: Internal kickoff with Elmstar infra to plan VPC peering and networking.
- 2026-03-08: Redwood technical deep-dive — agreed on 4-week POC for Dedicated.

POC scope (customer asks / acceptance criteria):
- Duration: 4 weeks (production-simulated traffic).
- Objective: validate Dedicated capacity meets 99th pctl latency < 150ms for chat L1 requests and sustained throughput of ~200 concurrent sessions with prefix caching.
- Cost target: within 1.2x unit cost of current hosted spend; prefer upfront commit if latency gains justify.
- Data controls: VPC peering + KMS integration for key management; all logs must flow to Elmstar audit pipeline for 90-day retention.

Canary + fallback routing plan (requested details):
- Canary strategy: route 5% production traffic to Dedicated pool running model-variant v1.0 (quantized), 95% to Hosted fallback during warmup. Ramp to 20% after 48h if error rate < 0.5% and latency SLO met.
- Model variants: primary = open-gpt-13b-quant (fast, 8-bit), fallback = open-gpt-13b-pt (higher-precision) and hosted-curie for lowest-cost fallthrough.
- Routing policies: latency-first for customer-facing chat (route to lowest-latency region + Dedicated if available), cost-fallback for batch embedding jobs (prefer hosted).
- Region failover: primary region = us-west-2 Dedicated pool; automatic failover to us-east-1 Dedicated pool if >1% request loss or control-plane unreachable for 30s. If no Dedicated capacity in failover region, route to Hosted API with sticky session annotations for user experience degradation messaging.
- Rollback criteria: automatic rollback to previous model-variant if model output quality regression detected (WER/API quality metric delta > 7% on eval prompt set) OR sustained 95th pctl latency breach >200ms for 5+ minutes. SE to run evaluation harness every 6 hours for regression checks.

Security & compliance notes:
- Elmstar requires SSO (SAML) integration and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM; Redwood to provide sample events schema.
- Data residency: production customer PII must remain in US regions only.
- Legal: Elmstar legal needs DPA + SOC2 Type II evidence before signing committed capacity.

Commercial / pricing notes:
- Elmstar prefers a 12-month reserved capacity quote with month-to-month true-up. Finance asked for a 3-tier pricing example (pilot, baseline, committed) with committed ARR scenarios.
- Will weigh cost vs predictability: sales asked for explicit unit economics showing 10%, 20% commit discounts and the impact of batching/quantization.

Quotes / customer sentiment (paraphrased):
- "We liked the Hosted API latency. Dedicated as a must for predictable SLAs and data isolation." — Head of Platform (M. Lopez)
- "Need a clean rollback story and automated routing; can't tolerate jitter during product launches." — Eng Lead (S. Patel)

Open technical questions to resolve in POC:
- Warmup strategy for KV cache priming across Dedicated pool nodes.
- Exact telemetry schema Redwood will emit for audit log ingestion.
- GPU type required to hit 150ms pctl (SE to bench a p4d vs a100 profile).

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-11: Send Dedicated POC runbook + infra checklist (Jordan).
- 2026-03-12: Legal to share DPA draft with Elmstar (Jordan / Legal).
- 2026-03-15: Schedule canary routing workshop with Priya and Elmstar infra.
